execution.ref: VALIDATOR-14, branch claude/validator-14-testnet-weights. Canonical: the new weight, eligibility, commitment, publication and study tests, plus the unchanged chain and battery suites, passed; the results are recorded in the PR.
execution.description: Testnet 567 winner weights now come from each Challenge validator's own promotions under the owner's 1/N, 24-hour, halving rule, with unpaid emissions burned every epoch.

expected: Winner weights could reuse the existing checked publisher with only a new intent family and a standing authorization.
observed: They could. The shared compiler's owner-associated-winner refusal also applies, so Carbon's own testnet miners need a coldkey that is not the owner's to win.
keep: Pay winners from the validator's promotion record, never from a ranking of scores.
Record each promotion once, at its first observed finalized time, so its decay clock cannot be reset by replay.
change: Register a Challenge's public baseline before launch, so the first winner must beat it.
protocol_elements: every Challenge's weight share is 1/N; its winner is its own validator's promotion; unpaid emissions burn every epoch
